_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Lining up tide, light and wind…

description: Rank the best time windows over the next 1–7 days for a coastal activity — tidepooling, beachcombing, clamming, fishing, paddling (kayak, SUP), boating, photography, or a beach walk — from predicted tides, daylight, and forecast wind, with the reasons for each window. Use for "best time to go tidepooling at … this weekend", "when should I launch my kayak", "good time for sunset photos at low tide". Identify the place with place (a name, optionally with a state), latitude + longitude, or station_id. If a name is not recognised the tool says so: call again with that place's latitude and longitude. A planning aid: it does not predict fish, surf, or safety. US coasts and territories.

activity.description: The activity. paddling covers kayak, SUP and canoe; beachcombing covers shelling and sea glass.

date.description: Local calendar date at the place, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today there.

days.description: How many consecutive local days to search, 1–7.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place being asked about, decimal degrees. Use with longitude when a place name is not recognised; approximate is fine.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place, decimal degrees (negative west).

place.description: The coastal place being asked about — a beach, harbor, bay, or town, optionally with a state: "Santa Cruz, CA".

station_id.description: 7-digit NOAA tide station ID, when already known from an earlier result.

units.description: imperial = feet, knots, °F (default). metric = meters, km/h, °C.

name: perigee_find_best_time

perigee.description: perigeetides.com page for the same answer; share it.

summary.description: One or two sentences that answer the question directly.

title: Best time to go
